items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: His name was Eddie Burns and we called him the Mole.

ctx.x: But they had different musicians by that time, because there was Mole /the drummer - what was his name? I know you called him Mole - the drummer? Burne (Burns)
His name was Eddie Burns and we called him the Mole.
